properties.title: Matter Controller
properties.pairing_help: Enter the 11-digit manual pairing code (e.g. 3497-011-2332) or the QR code content (MT:....). The device must be reachable on the IP network (WiFi/Ethernet or Thread via border router). If the device is already paired with another controller (Alexa, Google, Apple), use its "share/pair with another hub" function to obtain a new pairing code.
properties.qr_camera_insecure: The browser cannot use the webcam because the Node-RED editor is not open over HTTPS or localhost. Reopen it over HTTPS, or use Image.
properties.qr_camera_unsupported: This browser cannot access a webcam. Use a supported browser or load an image.
properties.qr_camera_permission_denied: Webcam permission was denied. Allow camera access in the browser, or load an image.
properties.qr_image_failed: No readable QR code was found in the selected image
properties.qr_invalid_matter: The QR code is not a Matter pairing code (MT:…).
properties.qr_found: Matter QR code read. Pairing starts automatically.
properties.qr_decoder_unavailable: The QR decoder could not be loaded.
properties.deploy_first: Deploy this configuration node first, then try again.
properties.pairing_wait: Pairing in progress. It can take up to a minute...
properties.pairing_hint: Prefer the QR code (MT:…): it carries the full device discriminator. The manual code stores only a short discriminator and can't reliably tell identical devices apart (e.g. several Shelly of the same model), which may pair the wrong one or report it as already commissioned. Pair one device at a time; if it's already paired elsewhere, factory-reset it first.
properties.storage_warning: The backup contains fabric credentials, private keys and commissioned-device data. Keep it secret like a password. Import replaces this controller's current Matter storage and briefly restarts it.
properties.storage_import_confirm: Replace this controller's Matter fabric and commissioned devices with the selected backup?
properties.storage_import_ok: Matter backup imported. The controller has restarted.
